verdict.rationale: The docs state that a Batch Processing API exists for high-volume processing, and asynchronous screening suits high-volume scenarios. This is a first-party bulk-ingest capability, but it gets only a single thin mention. Exports and webhook idempotency keys are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: batch job status/progress tracking, per-record error reporting, resume or retry after partial failure, explicit bulk transaction import, independent corroboration.
